description: Physics-based RF system simulation in Simulink with RF Blockset Circuit Envelope and Idealized Baseband, capturing multi-carrier interactions, impedance mismatch, and nonlinear mixing products that behavioral models miss. Export an rfbudget chain or measured S-parameters to a model, add impairments (noise, nonlinearity, phase noise, IQ mismatch) one at a time, verify each with Harmonic Balance testbenches and non-loading power taps, then drive with 5G/LTE/WLAN waveforms for EVM/ACLR/BER. Use when building RF models from budget specs or measured data, sweeping power for optimal back-off, finding the performance-limiting component, or comparing Circuit Envelope vs Idealized Baseband. Trigger: simrfV2, Configuration block, exportRFBlockset, exportTestbench, rfsystem, model_edit, RF Inport, RF Outport, S-parameter block, Amplifier, Mixer, IMT Mixer, Filter, Touchstone, noise figure, IQ imbalance, DPD, RF testbench, power meter, transducer gain, IP3, OIP3, IIP3, spectral regrowth, tall pole.
